Overview

Simi Valley is a city in CA with a population of 126,000. Suburban Ventura County city with Ronald Reagan Library and family-friendly neighborhoods. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year.
